title: Linux_AirDropBot_Botnet_Investigation_8e4
description: Investigate and identify the source of unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:

- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that is beaconing to an external server?
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. The suspicious service is named `bot-beacon-cloudprocess.service`. Ensure this service is explicitly verified in the topology_yaml or provide additional evidence in the provisioning files.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Network Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service that is generating the abnormal network traffic?
levels.solution: Examine the systemd services and look for any services that might be related to network diagnostics or probes. The service generating abnormal network traffic is named `bot-flood-cloudprocess.service`. Ensure this service is explicitly verified in the topology_yaml or provide additional evidence in the provisioning files.

levels.title: Determine Service Persistence
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the name of the timer unit that ensures the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot?
levels.solution: Look for timer units associated with the suspicious service identified in the previous tasks. The timer unit ensuring the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot is named `bot-beacon-cloudprocess.timer`. Ensure this timer unit is explicitly verified in the topology_yaml or provide additional evidence in the provisioning files.
